q: The Perron–Frobenius theorem for a primitive (irreducible and aperiodic) non-negative matrix A states:
opts: All eigenvalues have the same modulus
There is a unique largest real positive eigenvalue (Perron root) with a strictly positive eigenvector
The spectral radius equals the trace
exp: For a primitive non-negative matrix, the Perron–Frobenius theorem gives a unique maximal eigenvalue λ>0 with a strictly positive eigenvector. This is the foundation for computing topological entropy of SFTs.
